summary.title: SecureNova AI Identity Security
summary.description: AI-powered customer service platform threat model covering human users, AI agent, OAuth M2M client, LLM API key, RAG pipeline service identity, and MCP server identity, including authentication mechanisms, privilege levels, trust boundaries, and STRIDE threats.

threats.title: #1 Spoofed AI agent presents stolen OBO token
threats.description: An attacker intercepts or replays a stolen On-Behalf-Of JWT to impersonate a legitimate user session via the AI agent.
threats.mitigation: Enforce short-lived token lifetimes, sender-constrained tokens (DPoP/mTLS), and strict audience validation.

threats.title: #2 RAG context or tool arguments tampered
threats.description: Adversarial prompt injection modifies context embeddings or function call arguments prior to tool invocation.
threats.mitigation: Implement rigid JSON schema validation, input sanitation, and contextual guardrails.

threats.title: #3 Missing non-human identity audit trail
threats.description: Actions taken autonomously by the AI agent cannot be definitively correlated to the originating human initiator.
threats.mitigation: Correlate human session IDs with non-human M2M audit logs in tamper-proof immutable logging stores.

threats.title: #4 Prompt injection discloses LLM API key
threats.description: System prompt leakage or direct extraction attacks reveal backend API keys and model provider access tokens.
threats.mitigation: Isolate API keys in secure backend orchestration layers; never pass raw credentials in model context.

threats.title: #5 Unbounded tool loops exhaust quotas
threats.description: Malformed responses cause infinite recursive tool invocation loops, consuming downstream rate limits and API budgets.
threats.mitigation: Set strict recursion step limits, global execution timeouts, and circuit breakers on all tool calls.

threats.title: #6 Agent elevates to admin API scope
threats.description: A low-privileged user coerces the AI agent to invoke administrative internal APIs by abusing overly broad backend scopes.
threats.mitigation: Apply principle of least privilege, strict RBAC/ABAC enforcement, and scope downscoped tokens at tool runtime.

data.name: 1. Authentication Request
data.description: Human user initiates OIDC / OAuth 2.0 authentication against Auth0.

data.name: 2. Authentication Response (ID Token / Access Token)
data.description: Auth0 returns the ID token and access token to the authenticated user.

data.name: 3. User Request (Chat / Action)
data.description: Authenticated user sends a chat message or action request to the AI agent.

data.name: 4. ID Token / Identity Claims (JWT)
data.description: Identity claims exchanged between Auth0 and the AI agent: JWT presented for validation and identity claims returned (drawn bidirectional in the diagram).

data.name: 5. API Request + Access Token
data.description: AI agent calls internal business APIs presenting a scoped access token.

data.name: 6. API Response (Data)
data.description: Internal business APIs return business data to the AI agent.

data.name: 7. Knowledge Retrieval Request
data.description: AI agent issues a knowledge retrieval query to the RAG pipeline service identity.

data.name: 8. Retrieved RAG Chunks
data.description: RAG pipeline returns retrieved context chunks into the agent's model context.

data.name: 9. MCP Tool Invoke
data.description: AI agent invokes a tool exposed by the MCP server identity.

data.name: 10. Tool Response
data.description: MCP server returns the tool execution result to the AI agent.

data.name: M2M Client Credentials / Access Token
data.description: Client-credentials access token supplied to the AI agent for non-human machine-to-machine calls.

data.name: LLM API Key
data.description: Model provider access key supplied to the AI agent for LLM inference calls.

data.name: RAG Pipeline Service Identity Access
data.description: RAG pipeline service identity authenticates to the internal REST APIs.

data.name: MCP Server Identity Access
data.description: MCP server service identity chains through the RAG pipeline service identity.
